desc: Build exact ordered-pair BFS oracle and collect evidence for paths, trees, cycles, theta graphs, and endpoint gadgets.
Implement O((N+M) log N) solver using BFS distances, spare-vertex local gadgets, and fundamental-cycle enumeration from BFS trees rooted at S and T.
Validate the structural solver against the exact oracle on exhaustive connected graphs up to N=9, random graphs up to N=12, and all-cycle checks; no mismatches found.
Validate final implementation on the public samples.
